profile.name: Ahmed Egeh
profile.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full-Stack Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building production SaaS systems

experience.summary: Production SaaS at BidX across distributed systems and repositories: the Laravel and Vue product, Go and PHP middleware, internal dashboards, and the operational tools the team relies on.
highlights: Rebuilt scheduling as V1 then V2 on queue workers and AWS SQS. Missed executions dropped by 60%, and broken automation setups dropped by 90%.
Improved Amazon Selling Partner report processing so coverage grew from 3 days to 60 days per client, with reliable handling of up to 4 GB of XML per client.
Built support and admin tools for feature enablement, manual fixes, and data corrections, so operations move faster and stay more reliable.
Hardened production with clearer errors, better deploy tooling, monitoring, and static analysis, which cut recurring issues and sped up incident diagnosis.
Tightened Vue and Angular flows around localization, search, pagination, forms, and reporting so the product feels faster and more dependable.

experience.summary: Worked on the subscription and payments team at Cobrowser, a Symfony and Angular platform: subscriptions, payments, cart, shop integrations and keeping customer data safe. Conversation24 later acquired the company.
highlights: Built and kept subscription plans, payment flows and shopping cart features.
Found and fixed a subtle, recurring payment failure that had caused significant time loss and repeated refactoring.
Added AI-backed live translation for chat operators so they can talk with customers across languages in real time.
Connected API2Cart so external shops stay in sync with the product.
Added product presets for Facebook Catalog and WhatsApp customer journeys.
Wrote and maintained unit and integration tests with PHPUnit, Jest, and Karma.
